verdict.rationale: The bring-your-own-key half of the story is documented: the hosted plan says to 'just bring an LLM API Key' (docs-25), and community users report running AnythingLLM against API models such as GPT-4o and choosing between open and closed models (comm-1, comm-5, comm-7). Nothing in the pack shows any token-usage or cost tracking, per model or per conversation. Missing for 10: token usage display, cost tracking per model or per conversation, subscription-based backend support, any independent corroboration of usage visibility.
